text.p: Average yields at auctions of Ukrainian nine-month, 12-month and 18-month treasury bills were down from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Thursday.
Nine-month bills fell to 23.91 percent from 24.60 percent, 12-month bills to 24.23 percent from 24.76 percent and 18-month bills to 26.75 from 27.30 percent.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 38.00 million UAH 11.00 million UAH
Amount sold 38.00 million UAH 11.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 32.23 million UAH 9.29 million UAH
The central bank sold 380,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 26.60 million UAH 26.60 million UAH
Amount sold 26.60 million UAH 26.60 million UAH
Actual amount raised 21.42 million UAH 21.33 million UAH
The central bank sold 266,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills was not announced.
The results of the 18-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 31.00 million UAH 6.80 million UAH
Amount sold 31.00 million UAH 6.80 million UAH
Actual amount raised 22.14 million UAH 4.82 million UAH
The central bank sold 310,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 18-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
